reviews.t: Chocolate y pain au chocolat insuperables ❤️❤️❤️

En un mot "gentillesse" !! Un endroit rempli de gentillesse et de très bonnes choses à déguster ! Situé sur la place des artistes, cette boulangerie/salon de thé propose de magnifiques crêpes sucrées et salées ! Vous allez vous régaler, il y en a pour tous les goûts ! Ce jour-là avec une amie nous avons commandé des crêpes et en plus nous avons pris un pain au chocolat car il avait l'air très bon, nous avons bien fait il était miam ! Cette boulangerie est magnifique, l'intérieur fait très chic et le personnel est au petit soin :) J'ai hâte d'y retourner !!

Stopped by Carette’s Montmartre location after touring the neighborhood and it was the perfect break. The pain au chocolat and croissant were both exceptional—buttery, flaky, and incredibly fresh. Unlike some of Paris’ more famous cafés, we didn’t encounter any lines, which made the experience even more enjoyable. That said, this is a relatively small location, and I can easily see it getting busy with long queues during peak hours—perhaps we just got lucky with our timing. Service was quick and pleasant, and the relaxed atmosphere was a welcome respite after exploring Montmartre. A great spot for classic French pastries.

Tipica pasticceria storica situata nel quartiere Montmatre a due passi dalla basilica del
Sacro Cuore, di fronte alla piazza degli artisti (luogo molto suggestivo). Il locale offre svariate tipologie di dolci buonissimi per fare la classica colazione Francese. Croissant e pain au chocolat ottimi, buone anche le bevande. L'unico inconveniente è che non ci sono tavoli dove sedersi, pertanto è principalmente un locale da asporto.

By far my favourite place in Paris to get a hot chocolate - it's so chocolatey (I always get it with chantilly 😋) and I love the croissants and pain au chocolat too as they are huge. I get a takeaway and find a quiet spot to look at the view around the corner of the café
reviews.w: Modifié il y a un an

reviews.t: Fornaio/pasticceria situato nella zona Montmartre, a pochi passi dalla basilica del Sacro Cuore. Ottime crepes, ben farcite. Buoni anche i dolci (es. pain au chocolat). Prezzi giusti. Consigliato!
